Description

When I was in the open beta, I noticed that some worlds, my fps drops from 72fps, to around 40-50fps, and lower with quick menu on. My CPU isnt full in any of the logcial processors or overall utilisation graphs according to Task Manager. However, looking in SteamVR's Advanced Frame Timing shows its a CPU thing. I mostly notice it in the Fish! Game world. This doesn't happen in the regular game branch, that's why I am making a bug report for it, just in case it is something important.

When checking the worlds, I was the only one in the instance.

My Specs:

Radeon RX 9060XT

Ryzen 5 9600x

32GB DDR5

Using Quest 3 128GB, connected through Virtual Desktop on Medium Graphics Quality

Reproduction Steps

Join The Open Beta

Launch VRChat

Go to any of these worlds:

- Fish!

- Orbital Genesis

- A Game About Crates

- Break-n-Haul

There could be more but these are the ones I've noticed.

Workarounds:

I am unsure of any other workarounds other than being on the default branch.

Details

- Category: Performance

- Frequency: Often
